answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. What survives to the reef is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, reset on any identity-link attempt, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Each submission hangs on the shale of a task receipt, and the velvet is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
